result_preview.title: Equipment Maintenance and Change Impact Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates equipment diagnostics, maintenance requests, and configuration changes to optimize asset performance.
result_preview.description: This data product summarizes maintenance tickets, equipment status, and change request impacts across the production floor. It provides metrics on equipment downtime, change approval workflows, and their correlation to service ticket resolution times, enabling data-driven maintenance prioritization and change management optimization.

result_preview.title: Service Health Metrics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated ITSM performance analytics tracking ticket resolution times, equipment availability, and change success rates.
result_preview.description: This analytical data product aggregates key performance indicators across the ITSM domain, including mean time to resolution (MTTR) for service tickets, equipment uptime percentages, and change request success rates. It enables operations teams and service managers to monitor service quality trends, identify bottlenecks in request fulfillment, and optimize resource allocation for incident response and change management processes.

result_preview.title: Asset Maintenance and Change Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates maintenance, equipment, and change metrics for asset lifecycle insights.
result_preview.description: This data product aggregates maintenance tickets, IT equipment inventories, and change request workflows to provide comprehensive analytics on asset performance and operational changes. It summarizes equipment utilization rates, maintenance schedules, and change impact assessments, enabling proactive asset management and informed decision-making across manufacturing and IT operations.
